query:
-- Verificar quantos clientes retorna a query getAllowedClients (todos) vs getActiveAllowedClients (apenas ativos)
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) AS total_clientes,
  SUM(CASE WHEN is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ativos,
  SUM(CASE WHEN is_active = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inativos
FROM allowed_clients;
